$comment: Placeholder $id host - update once repo/GitHub Pages URL is finalized (ADR-0001, ADR-0003). Mirrors Spec v0.1 §3.
title: Evidence

sourceFile.description: Relative path within the vault to the source .md file.

sourceRef.description: Block reference within sourceFile - heading path + callout position. Optional but strongly recommended; without it a claim can't be traced back to an exact block, only a file.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601. Capture time (file mtime by default, or explicit `timestamp:` key in the callout), not event time.

context.description: Free text - typically the surrounding heading path.

observation.description: The actual claim this evidence supports. Empty observation is meaningless evidence, hence minLength 1.
